shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Health Canada said Sanofi Aventis Canada is recalling insulin pens and insulin cartridges that may have frozen during transport, affecting 11 batches and 1,043 units sold in July and August to about 80 pharmacies, clinics, and hospitals in Canada.

title: Sanofi Canada Recalls Insulin Pens and Cartridges That May Have Frozen in Transit
